verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for an identity-verification SaaS that stores sensitive ID images and extracted data, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to choose a storage region or residency location. Docs about accessing stored verification results and community worries about Stripe holding identity documents do not address region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
